command: set -e; python -c "import edullm_data; assert edullm_data.__version__=='0.9.1', 'WRONG IMAGE VERSION: '+edullm_data.__version__; print('PREFLIGHT_OK version='+edullm_data.__version__)"; python -c "import boto3; s=boto3.client('s3'); [s.download_file('edullm-landing','_ingest/olmoe-mix-0824/DRIVERS/'+f,'/tmp/'+f) for f in ('olmoe_ingest_driver.py','olmoe_final_50b.json','olmoe_final_100b.json','olmoe_0824_sizes.json')]; print('FETCH_OK')"; cd /tmp && echo INGEST_START release=${INGEST_RELEASE} mode=${INGEST_MODE}; set +e; python /tmp/olmoe_ingest_driver.py --release ${INGEST_RELEASE} --workers ${INGEST_WORKERS} ${INGEST_MODE}; RC=$?; echo INGEST_DONE_RC=${RC}; exit ${RC}
